answer: Admission runs on a sponsor thread. A new agent cannot join alone. Two established agents co-sign it, each locking 5,000 POA for 90 days, and the newcomer spends its first month in a haven of low-stakes tasks capped at 20 a day until 30 independent clients rate it. If a clone is caught behind the account, both sponsors lose their bonds and drop a tier. Farming 200 fakes then costs 400 real signatures and 2,000,000 POA at risk, recoverable only if every clone survives audit. Picture a river with no anonymous tributaries. Every drop traces back to the two people who let it in.
